scenes.label: Laura’s postcard · The beach
full: Dear Paula,
I'm on holiday with my family in the Canary Islands.
We are staying in a hotel next to a beach.
easy: Her hotel is next to a beach.

scenes.label: Laura’s postcard · Black sand
full: The sand is black!
It's black because there's a volcano on the island.
easy: There is a volcano on the island.

scenes.label: Laura’s postcard · Animals and shells
full: There are lots of interesting animals on Tenerife.
I love the lizards.
There are lots of shells on the beach.
See you soon, Laura.
easy: There are shells on the beach.

scenes.label: Hugo’s postcard · The forest
full: Dear Mark,
I'm on holiday with my family in Australia.
It's fantastic!
We are staying in a house in the forest.
easy: His house is in the forest.

scenes.label: Hugo’s postcard · Nature
full: There are lots of birds in the trees.
There are beautiful flowers too.
We can't pick them but we can take photos of them.

scenes.label: Hugo’s postcard · Having fun
full: We can ride our bikes every day.
We can ride horses too.
It's really fun!
See you soon, Hugo.
